name: mise
description: Set up and change mise in a repository: tools, environment values, tasks, the lockfile, test runs, and CI.

interface.shortDescription: Playbooks and templates for mise setups and test runs.
interface.longDescription: Gives an agent playbooks for a new mise setup, for changes to tools, environment values and tasks, and for test runs that scale by one task per suite. It also has a chooser for backends, task forms and config files, templates, and a script that checks a repository's setup.
defaultPrompt: Set up mise for this repository.
Add an integration test suite to the mise tasks.
